# `kernel/arch/i386/isa` — ISA bus and PC-compatible hardware support (PIC, PIT, keyboard, serial, ATAPI)

## English

This directory contains ISA bus and PC-compatible hardware support (PIC, PIT, keyboard, serial, ATAPI).

`config.mk` records 16 source file(s) here: `clock.c`, `com.c`, `fd.c`, `icu.s`, `if_apx.c`, `if_ec.c`, `if_ne.c`, `if_we.c`, `isa.c`, `locore.s`, `machdep.c`, `npx.c`, ....

Subdirectories: `ic/`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
